question_vi: Background Tasks vs Celery — khi nào dùng cái nào?
question_en: Background Tasks vs Celery — when to use each?
answer_vi: Background Tasks: zero config, in-process, chạy sau khi response trả về client. Dùng cho: email xác nhận đơn giản, logging, non-critical async work. Celery: cần Redis/RabbitMQ broker, distributed workers, retry logic, monitoring với Flower. Dùng cho: payment processing, report generation, critical tasks cần retry. Lưu ý: Background Tasks bị mất nếu server restart — Celery persist tasks trong broker.
answer_en: Background Tasks: zero config, in-process, runs after response is sent. Use for: simple emails, logging, non-critical work. Celery: needs Redis/RabbitMQ, distributed workers, retry, Flower monitoring. Use for: payments, reports, critical tasks needing retry. Pitfall: BackgroundTasks are lost on server restart — Celery persists in broker.
